description: Calculate a Human Design chart: type, strategy, authority, profile, definition, centers and channels, with approved plain-English texts and a link to their chart card. Use when someone asks "what's my Human Design", "am I a Generator or a Projector", "what's my authority / profile", or shares a birthday and wants their design. The positions come from an ephemeris checked against the Swiss Ephemeris, so never guess a type from memory. birth_time is optional: without it the chart is worked out for every half hour of the day and the result says which parts depend on the time. time_zone is the IANA zone of the birthplace.

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago or Europe/London.

name: get_human_design_chart
